original_metadata.title: Every finite-dimensional real semisimple Lie algebra has a rational form carrying rational forms of all its finite-dimensional real representations
original_metadata.author: Dave Witte Morris
original_metadata.source_title: A Cohomological Proof that Real Representations of Semisimple Lie Algebras Have Q-Forms
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The proof chooses a rational quasi-split form and modifies the twisting cocycle through central quotients so that every real-vanishing Tits obstruction also vanishes rationally. Its construction uses weak approximation for norm-one tori to lift the real cocycle, then analyzes unitary factors and central characters to establish universality simultaneously for all dominant weights.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete Section2 author proof read: Tits highest-weight obstruction framework, Corollary2.4 universality criterion, Lemma2.5 norm-one torus lifting and the full central-quotient/cocycle construction for Proposition1.2. Tits representation classification and weak approximation are explicitly prior established background. The resulting Q-form has scalar extension equal to the prescribed real Lie algebra and every finite-dimensional real representation is conjugate to rational matrices. No lattice-integrality corollary or classification of particular rational Lie algebra types is counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Proposition1.2: for every finite-dimensional real semisimple Lie algebra g_R there exists a Lie algebra g_Q over Q with g_Q tensor_Q R isomorphic to g_R, such that every finite-dimensional real representation of g_Q is real-conjugate to a representation over Q. This does not assert that every rational form is universal.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: Lemma2.5 writes H1(L/F;G(L)) although the base field throughout that lemma and its proof is Q, and near the end writes T(R) where the norm-one locus is defined in T(C). The lemma opening and explicit restriction-of-scalars construction specify these objects. Original source pages remain unchanged.
original_metadata.source_boundary_note: The full original universal rational-form Proposition 1.2 and complete Section 2 cohomological author proof are supplied. This is one simultaneous outcome for every finite-dimensional real representation of the constructed Q-form. The Tits highest-weight obstruction framework, universality criterion, norm-one-torus lifting, central-quotient cocycle construction, unitary-factor analysis and all real-vanishing/rational-vanishing obstruction comparisons are retained. Tits classification and weak approximation remain named established prerequisites. Original F/Q and torus-locus symbols are preserved with their source notice. No lattice-integrality corollary, particular-type classification or claim that every rational form is universal is selected.
